snippet.title: Unseen Shekhawati Wedding Food/प्रीति भोज in Mandawa, Rajasthan I Sweets, Namkeen, Ker Sangri, Bade
snippet.description:
Mandawa, a small town in Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan, has become a favourite wedding destination because of its royal touch—ornate havelis, cobbled streets, and a timeless heritage that set the perfect backdrop for celebrations. We were here to witness the chaak bhaat ceremony of Shubham and Tamana, a pre-wedding ritual steeped in warmth, tradition, and flavour.

The day began early with preparations for the preeti bhoj, the community feast that brings everyone together. The kitchen buzzed with activity—khasta kachori being fried to golden perfection, halwa gently bubbling, ker sangri slow-cooked with local spices, and aalu vada and dahi vada being carefully plated. The flavours were bold and spicy, with besan and legumes as key ingredients.

After the rituals, guests were welcomed with flavoured milk and snacks. The main course began, as tradition dictates, with four kinds of sweets and namkeen served first. Only then did the rest of the meal follow, offered with warmth and generosity.

What we witnessed was more than just a meal—it was a deep-rooted food tradition where community, celebration, and flavour come together. A cuisine shaped by the desert, built on humble ingredients, and carried forward with pride and affection.

snippet.title: Ep 6 BTS Puducherry to Mahabalipuram, Alamparai fort | Sea Food | Tamil Nadu Tour
snippet.description:
Puducherry to Mahabalipuram is about 100 km away,, we thought to take it easy on this day, so started the day late.

This is youtube channel visa2explore is about our behind the scene content but on this day we didn’t record any other video on visa2explore, which is our main channel.
Just in case if you have missed watching our Tamil Nadu series from beginning you may check out the playlist on our youtube channel Visa2explore and Harish Bali travels.

Spices website link - https://spice2nuts.com/

Gadgets we use for Visa2explore & Harish Bali Travels.
Sony A 7 111 camera: https://amzn.to/4clE2zI
Z -90 Sony: https://amzn.to/3SO8T10
Go pro Hero 12: https://amzn.to/46GULw6
IPhone 15 Pro: https://amzn.to/3YJgr8Y

For Background Music, we use “Epidemic Sound” in our videos. You can use it from the link below.

https://www.epidemicsound.com/referral/ujnsd6

Date of Journey - 9th jan 2025

Seaside Guest House - We ended our day at our hotel. We booked a sea side facing room here. This guest house is run by Sr. Aurobindo ashram.
Tariff -  Rs 4200 for double occupancy.
You may check out the accommodations on this website- https://aurosociety.org/society/index/Accommodation

The location of this hotel is at Promenade Road, Puducherry.

Alamparai Fort - Enroute to Mahabalipuram,  We visited the remains of this old fort located on the shore of the sea.

Lunch - Rose village restaurant - we ordered veg thali - Rs 120. 
Mudaliar Kuppam  - 
Boat House - Boating charge - Rs 1000 for 8 people boat ride in the lake. 

Hotel Ramakrishna  - we paid Rs 2500 for double occupancy without breakfast located in Mahabalipuram in the market area. Stay at this hotel was average

After that we fixed the Itinerary for Mahabalipuram with Mr. Santosh who is going to guide us in the tour. 

we paid him fee of Rs 4500, actually our day is super hectic for anyone, so paid more otherwise i think he charges less.

Guide contact number - santosh - 9087504766

Dinner  at Bambino - This restaurant located near the beach, you get beautiful view from the restaurant itself, if you are sea food lover, they would show you fresh catch of the day, on the basis of customer choice, they would cook.

We ordered Red Snapper Tawa fry - Rs 1400.

Hope you enjoyed the video.

snippet.title: #AD Can I Eat For A Full Day In Delhi with Just ₹750?
snippet.description:
Tried eating in Delhi for a full day with just ₹750 and honestly it turned out better than expected.
Started the day at Andhra Bhavan with a proper South Indian breakfast. Filling, comforting and great value for money. After that I went to see India Gate or whatever was visible that day.

Lunch was classic Delhi food. Palak paneer, rice and papad from Jain Chawal Wale. Simple, quick and exactly what you want when you are eating on a budget.

By evening hunger kicked in again while waiting for the match, so instead of stepping out I ordered a snack at home. Tried Cheetos International Cheese which is now available on Blinkit for around ₹100. Cheesy, crunchy and easy to snack on.

Dinner was at Majnu Ka Tila with laphing and a hot bowl of thukpa and I ended the day with a beer gelato. Full day done and challenge sorted.

About the show :- 
_________________

Crime Patrol is a gripping Indian television series that brings to life real crime stories from across the country through powerful dramatizations and thought-provoking narratives. Each episode reflects how ordinary moments—an uneasy silence, a lingering stare, a heated argument—can spiral into unimaginable tragedies when the warning signs are ignored. The show explores not just the crime itself, but the emotional triggers, behavioral shifts, and overlooked instincts that often precede it, asking: could the crime have been prevented if we had paid closer attention? By highlighting the psychological and social cues behind criminal acts, Crime Patrol urges viewers to stay alert, trust their instincts, and understand that awareness is the first step to safety. Through its realistic storytelling and focus on justice, the series also honors the tireless efforts of law enforcement and the resilience of victims, serving both as a cautionary tale and a tribute to the fight against crime.
